# Narrivy

> Narrivy is a free, open-source (MIT) desktop app for offline voice typing and speech-to-text on Linux and Windows. A keyboard shortcut starts dictation, and the recognised text is typed into the focused app. It also records meetings, runs a local AI assistant and provides a grammar and writing assistant for Chrome and Brave. All speech recognition and language models run locally on the user's NPU, GPU or CPU; there is no account, no telemetry and no cloud processing.

Key facts:

- Platforms: Pop!_OS 24.04 (COSMIC, Wayland) and 64-bit Windows 11. Current version: 1.0.0-rc.33 (release candidate). Packages: `.deb` and `.msi`.
- Speech models: Whisper (about 100 languages, including English and Urdu) and Parakeet. Models are downloaded on first run and verified by SHA-256.
- Hardware: Intel Core Ultra NPU through an optional OpenVINO add-on; Intel, AMD and NVIDIA GPUs through Vulkan; any modern x86-64 CPU.
- Dictation features: live overlay, local clean-up of filler words and punctuation, echo cancellation, noise suppression, custom vocabulary, pipelines with their own shortcut and model, History.
- Built with Rust and Tauri; React interface.
